# Prole Adventures

> A field guide to places where people can still make a life, based on on-the-ground reporting about cost, safety, access, atmosphere and everyday life.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://proleadventures.com/): Start here for Prole Adventures.
- [About](https://proleadventures.com/about): What the project is and why places shape the lives people can make.
- [League](https://proleadventures.com/league): Ranked on-the-ground place audits covering rent, everyday costs, safety and access.
- [Prole Control](https://proleadventures.com/prole-control): Active and completed field missions and place audits.
- [Stories](https://proleadventures.com/stories): Field reports, investigations and dispatches.

## Practical resources

- [Gear](https://proleadventures.com/gear): Practical gear used for travel, documentation and field reporting.
- [Shop](https://proleadventures.com/shop): Clothing and field items that support reporting.
- [Watch](https://proleadventures.com/watch): Video reports and completed adventures.
- [Contact](https://proleadventures.com/contact): Share a place, field report or collaboration idea.
